extras.real_size: halberd, 2.10 m (head approx. 44 cm long, axe blade 30 cm tall)
extras.notes: long ash shaft with two leather-wrapped grip sections between brass ferrules and a brass butt cap; steel head with socket, broad axe blade with soft rounded edge and round corners, short blunt rounded hook on the back (no spike), blunt leaf-shaped top point with a soft central ridge, two brass langets with rivets, small red tassel lying on the ground below the head; lies flat (z = 0), long axis = X (head at +X), blade towards -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
